readerCopy.headline: More power does not make the terms fair.
readerCopy.body:
The deal may look different once you see who can change the scope, hold access, set the price, or take credit. A bigger opportunity can come with more dependence on one person or system. You may be offered responsibility that sounds flattering until you notice how little authority you actually have over the outcome.

Jupiter square Pluto raises the stakes on the agreement. Read the part after the flattering part. If the responsibility grew, the authority, pay, support, or right to say no should be visible too. More is not automatically better when somebody else controls the terms.
doNotAssume: Do not assume exploitation, a bad employer, legal trouble, or that the opportunity must be rejected.
